detail.longDescription: I’ve been looking into self-hosting IPTV for a future project (honestly in a few years time) - and I decided to test out "NostalgiaTV", a closed-source but free (on the server side, the app has a one-time payment for 50% of it's features) solution. Now NTV isn't actually marketed as self-hosting IPTV, but instead a way to recreate TV of old with local content playing like live TV, and comes bundled with tons of "channels" with parody names (even 1 for the BBC which I find surprising)! :neobot_giggle: NTV just happens also be good as a general IPTV. In terms of my personal testing: Overall it works pretty well, and being able to manually add or remove content is neat... But I've found that anything not using H.264 codec doesn't work (which I think is something with Firefox as it's been a historic problem for me), and I don't think my server is powerful enough: when it does load it typically stalls out. So it may be an on-device thing. # nostalgiatv # iptv # selfhosting # docker # testing # testdeployment # selfhost
